prompts.sem:
Create a production pixel-art WALK ANIMATION ATLAS. Image 1 is the EXACT POSE LAYOUT and must be obeyed cell by cell. Image 2 is ONLY the character identity/costume/style reference, not the pose. Dress the stick figures from image 1 as Kia from image 2. Exactly EIGHT columns, FOUR rows, 32 complete characters. Keep hip centers and overall height stationary cell-to-cell. Keep all feet within cells.
The BLUE and PINK limbs in image1 indicate two DIFFERENT legs. Reproduce their alternate forward/behind positions, but render them in her original dark trousers and brown boots, NOT blue or pink. In FRONT and BACK rows columns1,2,8 the SCREEN-LEFT boot is lower; columns4,5,6 the SCREEN-RIGHT boot is lower; columns3,7 feet pass at same height, one knee lifted. These differences are mandatory. In profile rows, the leg shaded darker alternates from behind to in front after 4 frames exactly as guide. DO NOT repeat the first four poses in the last four cells. Frame5 has OPPOSITE leading leg to frame1. Eight equally spaced phases of one full two-step walk cycle, no limping.
No weapons; arms swing opposite the legs.
Preserve long dark-brown hair, face, white rolled-sleeve blouse, charcoal vest, diagonal red sash and belt, charcoal pants and brown boots from identity reference. Same costume, proportions, size, head/hip position and camera throughout. Front, back, left profile, right profile as the four guide rows. Pixel art, crisp dark outlines, restrained lighting. TRUE TRANSPARENT background. No stick figures, colored limbs, text, grids, diagrams, shadows, floor or background. Leave generous empty gutters between sprites.
